label: caiso r1 signflip off
definition: (PROBE) B-LIMB-1 R1: caiso-51-firm-base with the unidentified sign-flip temperature-CF limb SP15/CC_REGULAR tmax DISABLED (D-8 §2B: Spearman ρ +0.69→−0.10 train→holdout; decision rule R1, CLAUDE.md rule 17). Same-env A/B vs the caiso-r1-baseline-limb run shows the limb was NON-BINDING: CC_REGULAR Δ≤0.018 TWh, CT_PEAKER/ST_GAS Δ≈0, price/CO2/forced-share identical — removing the unidentified floor costs ~0 dispatch. Structural change judged on identification, not fit (rule #1).
market_story: The SP15/CC_REGULAR tmax reliability floor was the only live limb of the three B-LIMB-1 sign-flip limbs (PJM ComEd and CAISO SP15/ST_GAS already shipped disabled). In the caiso-51 dispatch CAISO gas-CC clears economically well above the floor's min-stable level on hot SP15 days, so the floor never bound; disabling it (R1) shifts <0.03% of CC energy. The floor was unidentified scaffolding doing no structural work — R1's best case. NOTE: the large apparent CT_PEAKER shrink vs the COMMITTED caiso-51 bundle is main-drift since 2026-07-03 (see baseline run), not this change.
